items.title: Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Strengthening Its Defense Pipeline With Two Major Contract Wins?
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) secured a contested US$10.5b U.S. Special Operations logistics contract after a formal challenge was resolved. The contractor was also identified as a leading contender for the UK Ministry of Defence’s proposed £2b military satellite program. Labor unions and elected officials in both countries are pressing for clarity on jobs, oversight, and long term sourcing commitments tied to these awards. items.title: Amazon Lost 40 Leo Satellites as Launch Stays “Extremely Constrained.” That Widens SpaceX’s Lead
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket failed on Sunday and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites on the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has bought. Amazon can easily afford new satellites, but Vulcan was supposed to carry more than 1,500 of them, and few other rockets have room for the rest.

items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.
